name: Black Cat Syndicate Limited
summary: Black Cat Syndicate Limited engages in the exploration and development of gold properties in Australia. It holds a 100% interest in the Bulong gold project, which covers an area of 347 square kilometers located to the east of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia. It also holds a 100% interest in the Fingals gold project, which covers an area of 368 square kilometers located south east of Bulong; and the Rowes Find gold project, which covers an area of 41 square kilometers located in east of Bulong. Black Cat Syndicate Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in West Perth, Australia.
